headline: DeepMind CEO calls for AI standards body to regulate frontier models
summary: Google DeepMind CEO proposes independent regulator for frontier AI models
details: DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis has called for the creation of a new regulatory body to oversee frontier model releases. The proposed system would build on ad hoc reviews performed by the US government.

The regulator, modeled after the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA), would test frontier models and develop best practices for their release. It would be staffed by open-source representatives and technical experts from within the industry.

The proposed regulator would be backed by the US government but funded by the AI industry and operated independently. Hassabis argues that this approach would be technically focused while supporting innovation and incentivizing responsible behavior.

headline_marked: Plex [[experiencing major issues]] with multiple services, users report
headline: Plex experiencing major issues with multiple services, users report
summary: Plex services are down for many users, affecting streaming and content access.
details: Plex services have been experiencing major issues today, with multiple users reporting problems on Plex’s forums and on Reddit. Many people use Plex as a way to stream shows and movies they host locally, but users are upset because today’s problems are reportedly affecting their ability to do that.

The company has confirmed ‘unexpected issues’ with multiple services, including free streaming movies and shows, the plex.tv API, Discover Together, and program guide data for live TV. The issues have been going on for more than an hour.

Plex acknowledged the problems on X, saying that 'We are currently aware and investigating some unexpected issues with Plex, including Live TV, our on demand services, and our API services' and pointing users to the Plex Status page.
